sections.body:
Our events give people across broadcasting, streaming and technology the space to connect, learn and collaborate.

A welcoming, inclusive setting and limited attendance give people more time and space to talk.

sections.body:
Anyone can request an invitation. Requesting an invitation does not guarantee attendance. The Media Collective curates each event and decides whether it is the right fit for the applicant.

Applicants should receive a response by email within 5 working days. If accepted, they receive a link to register for the event. Membership is not required. All events are free to attend.
